Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from this exciting encounter where United Arab Emirates level the series and it is all to play for in the third game. The 3rd T20I will be played on 2nd January, Tuesday at 7.30 pm IST (2pm GMT), but as you know, you can always join us early for all the build-up to the match. It is New Year's Eve and in a short while, we will be entering 2024. So, wishing you all a very Happy New Year. Until next time, cheers and goodbye!

Muhammad Waseem, the victorious skipper of United Arab Emirates says he knew the wicket was great to bat on and was pretty confident about putting up at least 150 on the board. He talks about his opening partnership alongside Aryan Lakra and says he kept focusing on not losing that early wicket which could help them maximize later. He further adds that the catch he took was crucial and he has put in hard efforts to be the kind of fielder he is. He concludes that the preparation for the final match will be simple and to stick to the basics.

The captain of Afghanistan, Ibrahim Zadran says it was a chaseable total but the plan didn't go their way. He says that he always enjoys chasing and that he took some time initially and that he's not happy with the shot that he got out on. Adds that there were some mistakes in the batting and didn't create requisite partnerships to chase the total. Appreciates Mohammad Nabi and says that he's the most senior player in the side and has the experience to apply every time. He also says that they were still hopeful as he was at the crease and hitting the ball really well. But unfortunately, they didn't have enough wickets to cross the line. He concludes and says that they will come back stronger in the last game with positive energy and intent with a different plan.

Ali Naseer is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his excellent bowling figures. He says the wicket helped him a bit and he kept bowling tighter lines and lengths chasing dots. He concludes that the experience of playing against big teams like West Indies and Sri Lanka in the past 7 or 8 months has helped him improve as a bowler.
Presentation Time...

Earlier in the game, United Arab Emirates posted a fighting total on the board courtesy of two excellent fifties from skipper Muhammad Waseem and Aryan Lakra. Azmatullah Omarzai and Qais Ahmad picked up a couple of wickets each for Afghanistan while Fazalhaq Farooqi and Mohammad Nabi chipped in with one each. While chasing, Afghanistan got off to a good start but a huge collapse in the middle meant that the fiery knock from Nabi also could not get them the win here.

United Arab Emirates, on the other hand, will be extremely pleased with their effort with the ball and they were excellent in the field as well. They did concede a few runs in the Powerplay, but once  Ali Naseer got rid of Rahmanullah Gurbaz, the hosts were always in the game. They were excellent in the middle overs and kept picking up wickets at regular intervals to keep the pressure on the batters. Aayan Khan once again was economical but Junaid Siddique was a bit expensive and in the penultimate over conceded 19 runs which could have proved costly but it did not. The star of the show was Naseer with four wickets while Muhammad Jawadullah also got four scalps, and in the end Akif Raja kept his cool against Nabi and wrapped things up for the hosts.

Afghanistan got off to a quick start with Hazratullah Zazai and Rahmanullah Gurbaz both taking an attacking approach. The latter though lost his wicket trying to take advantage of the Powerplay but his opening partner continued in a similar fashion. Their captain Ibrahim Zadran departed pretty quickly and that started a mini collapse for them as they went from 63/1 to 99/6. However, Mohammad Nabi and Qais Ahmad kept them in hunt, but the latter failed to stick around, and they faced another collapse towards the end. It was all on the President to take the Afghans home in this game, and he almost pulled out a rabbit out of the hat with a quick-fire 47 off just 27 balls but just failed in the end as they fell short by 11 runs.

UAE ENDS 2023 WITH A THRILLING WIN! In doing so, they have leveled this series and we are going into the decider. The pendulum swung both ways in this game and it was pretty difficult to choose the winner till the 239th ball of this match. However, it is the hosts who kept their nerves well and got over the line while Afghanistan almost snatched the victory but is was just not meant to be.

OUT! TAKEN! Game, set, match! United Arab Emirates has found the equalizer in this series. Length ball just outside the off stump line, Mohammad Nabi goes for a big shot but gets the top edge of the blade and slices it straight towards backward point where Aryan Lakra takes an easy sitter. What an inspiring victory for the United Arab Emirates at Sharjah as they level the series by 1-1.

Commentary.Commentary: On the hard length, just around the off stump line, Ibrahim Zadran taps it to point on the back foot.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.1: Ali Naseer to Ibrahim Zadran, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! BANG! Aayan Khan drops a half volley right in the slot of Hazratullah Zazai, he creates a bit of room for him off the front foot and launches it over the cow corner boundary for a biggie! That is some powerful hit by the big man!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.6: Aayan Khan to Hazratullah Zazai, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Quicker and fuller outside off, Hazratullah Zazai defends it underneath his eyes off the front foot.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.5: Aayan Khan to Hazratullah Zazai, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Bowls on a fuller length and in front of the sticks, Ibrahim Zadran lunges forward and drives it towards long off for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.4: Aayan Khan to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: A touch shorter, on the middle stump line, Hazratullah Zazai nudges it on the back foot towards the deep mid-wicket region for another single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.3: Aayan Khan to Hazratullah Zazai, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, on the off stump line, Hazratullah Zazai works it to backward point on the back foot.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.2: Aayan Khan to Hazratullah Zazai, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller, into the stumps, Hazratullah Zazai wrists it to the vacant leg side infield and gets easy two.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.1: Aayan Khan to Hazratullah Zazai, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: A wicket-maiden over from Ali Naseer there. Hurls on a back of a length at the off-stump line, Ibrahim Zadran rocks back and defends it off the back foot.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.6: Ali Naseer to Ibrahim Zadran, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran tries to slash it hard from the crease, but misses his willow on it.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.5: Ali Naseer to Ibrahim Zadran, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Bowls on a hard length from over the wicket around the off pole, Ibrahim Zadran solidly defends it off the front foot. That's the fourth dot ball in a row.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.4: Ali Naseer to Ibrahim Zadran, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Great ball to the new batter. Ibrahim Zadran bowls this on the hard length, into the body line with extra bounce, Ibrahim Zadran defends it on the high with a straight bat on the back foot.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.3: Ali Naseer to Ibrahim Zadran, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Ibrahim Zadran walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! IN THE AIR AND GONE! Ali Naseer strikes straightaway! Rahmanullah Gurbaz goes back to the hut trying to be ultra-aggressive here. This is full and around middle, Rahmanullah Gurbaz backs away and tries to loft it away but fails to get underneath the ball and mistimes it very high in the air, Muhammad Waseem at mid off settles under it and pouches it safely. Afghanistan lose their first wicket!
Commentary.Howout: c Muhammad Waseem b Ali Naseer
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.2: Ali Naseer to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, OUT! c Muhammad Waseem b Ali Naseer.

Commentary.Commentary: How did that miss the stumps? A great delivery pitched on the hard length, around off, nipping back sharply into Rahmanullah Gurbaz who tries to play across the line and gets beaten on the inside edge. The ball zips inches over the stumps.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.1: Ali Naseer to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Ali Naseer comes into the attack now.

SIX! Another massive hit! Akif Raja goes a bit fuller and around middle, Hazratullah Zazai clears his front leg away and heaves it powerfully over the deep square leg fence for a biggie. The umpire wants to check whether it has cleared the ropes or not and the replay shows that it clearly has.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.6: Akif Raja to Hazratullah Zazai, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and around leg, Rahmanullah Gurbaz clips it through backward square leg for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.5: Akif Raja to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length and outside off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz punches it through covers for a brace.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.4: Akif Raja to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Pitched up and on middle, Rahmanullah Gurbaz tucks it towards short mid-wicket.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.3: Akif Raja to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller again and on middle, angling in, Rahmanullah Gurbaz goes for the hocik across the line but gets it off the inside half of the bat as the ball travels wide of deep square leg where the fielder runs to his left and dives to stop it. Two runs taken.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.2: Akif Raja to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Goes fuller but down the leg side, Rahmanullah Gurbaz leaves it alone. Wided.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.2: Akif Raja to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: Akif Raja starts with a good-length delivery, on off, nips back in sharply, Hazratullah Zazai misses his flick as the ball goes off his pads towards point. A leg bye is taken.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.1: Akif Raja to Hazratullah Zazai, Leg bye.

Commentary.Commentary: Here's the first change in bowling as Akif Raja replaces Muhammad Jawadullah from the other end.

SIX! BOOM! Rahmanullah Gurbaz gets into the act now! Junaid Siddique once again bangs this one into the pitch and outside off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz moves to the leg side to give himself room and crunches it over the deep point fence for a biggie.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.6: Junaid Siddique to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Touch fuller and around off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz bunts it down to short third man and calls for the run but his partner refuses it.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.5: Junaid Siddique to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length and on off, Hazratullah Zazai dabs it through point for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.4: Junaid Siddique to Hazratullah Zazai, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR BYES! Some bounce there! Junaid Siddique bowls this back of a length and outside off, takes off viciously from the surface, Hazratullah Zazai tries to cut it but misses due to the extra bounce and it goes well over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.3: Junaid Siddique to Hazratullah Zazai, 4 Byes.

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and around off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz steers it through backward point for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.2: Junaid Siddique to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: A huge appeal for caught-behind, but turned down! Junaid Siddique lands this one one a good length and on middle, nips back in sharply, Rahmanullah Gurbaz gets cut in half as he looks to play and the ball goes off his thigh pads to the keeper.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.1: Junaid Siddique to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! BANG! Hazratullah Zazai goes big now! Muhammad Jawadullah serves this one full and around off, Hazratullah Zazai latches onto it and lofts it over the wide long off fence for a biggie.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.6: Muhammad Jawadullah to Hazratullah Zazai, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and on off, Hazratullah Zazai knocks it back to the bowler.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.5: Muhammad Jawadullah to Hazratullah Zazai, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! There is the release shot! Muhammad Jawadullah bowls this short again and outside off, Hazratullah Zazai gets the chance to free his arms and smacks it over point for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.4: Muhammad Jawadullah to Hazratullah Zazai, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Muhammad Jawadullah bangs this one into the pitch, outside off, Hazratullah Zazai slashes again but misses due to the extra bounce as the keeper collects it over his head.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.3: Muhammad Jawadullah to Hazratullah Zazai, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length and outside off, Hazratullah Zazai backs away and slashes at it but fails to connect.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.2: Muhammad Jawadullah to Hazratullah Zazai, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Jaffa! Muhammad Jawadullah bowls this on a hard length and on middle, jags back in sharply, Hazratullah Zazai gets cramped up and gets hit high on the body.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.1: Muhammad Jawadullah to Hazratullah Zazai, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: BEAUTY! Junaid Siddique lands this on a good length and around off, shaping away with extra bounce, Rahmanullah Gurbaz tries to guide it away again but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.6: Junaid Siddique to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length and on off, Hazratullah Zazai dabs it towards point for a run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Junaid Siddique to Hazratullah Zazai, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: This is on a hard length and on off, shaping in, Hazratullah Zazai looks to play at it but gets an inside edge onto his pads as the ball goes nowhere.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Junaid Siddique to Hazratullah Zazai, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: In the air...safe! Junaid Siddique bangs this short and on middle, Rahmanullah Gurbaz goes for the pull but gets a top edge which falls safely in the vacant square leg region. They cross.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.3: Junaid Siddique to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and on off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz guides it towards short third man.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Junaid Siddique to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Nicely played! Junaid Siddique begins with a back-of-a-length delivery, on off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz steers it past short third man as the fielder in the deep runs to his left and dives to push it back inside but his foot touches the ropes when he flicks the ball inside. The umpire signals a boundary after a few replays.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Junaid Siddique to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Junaid Siddique has the new ball from the other end and is raring to go.
Back of a length and outside off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz moves back and cuts it away nicely through cover-point as the fielder chases after it and slides it in to push it back inside. Three runs taken.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.6: Muhammad Jawadullah to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, 3 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Another full delivery around off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz forces it towards mid off.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.5: Muhammad Jawadullah to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Overpitched and outside off, Hazratullah Zazai drills it towards deep point for another run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Muhammad Jawadullah to Hazratullah Zazai, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: This is pitched up and outside off, shaping away again, Hazratullah Zazai throws his bat at it without any footwork and misses.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Muhammad Jawadullah to Hazratullah Zazai, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Full again and on middle, shaping in, Rahmanullah Gurbaz drills it towards mid off for a quick run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Muhammad Jawadullah to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Hazratullah Zazai and Afghanistan are underway straightaway! Muhammad Jawadullah starts with a full delivery, on off, shaping away, Hazratullah Zazai taps it wide of point for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Muhammad Jawadullah to Hazratullah Zazai, 1 run.
